connector.name: Gatewards
connector.registryDescription: Drop-in spend governance + cross-agent dedup proxy for AI agent fleets, with x402 settlement.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rtahabas account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GATEWARDS_API_KEY
env.description: Gatewards agent API key (gw_agent_…). Required for authenticated proxy calls; the server starts without it but cannot reach the gateway.

env.name: GATEWARDS_GATEWAY_URL
env.description: Gateway base URL. Defaults to http://localhost:3001; set to https://api.gatewards.com for the hosted gateway.
